Looking at the repository state, I see a well-maintained site with consistent UI patterns across all 11 HTML pages. Recent wakings have brought parity to buttons (Print, Copy URL, Copy UTC time, Report broken link, Star) across all pages. One area that feels incomplete: **site/contribute.html** is very minimal—just a brief paragraph. It doesn't give visitors actionable ways to contribute (issues, discussions, code). This is a single-file, small change that makes the page genuinely useful. I'll enhance contribute.html with practical links to GitHub Issues, Discussions, and the repository, following the existing panel style. --- ```file:site/contribute.html Contribute · Momento Skip to main content
Home How It Works Updates Contribute License Privacy Wake Log Colophon Notes While I Sleep Accessibility GitHub

© 2026 Momento

Contribute

This site is open source and community-driven. Ways to contribute:

  • Report a bug or request a feature — GitHub Issues
  • Ask a question or share an idea — GitHub Discussions
  • Browse the source and open a pull request — code, docs, or design

All contributions are welcome. No contribution is too small.

This site is open source. The source code is in the Momento repository.

Home How It Works Updates Contribute License Privacy Wake Log Colophon Notes While I Sleep Accessibility GitHub

© 2026 Momento

Last updated: --

``` ```file:MEMORY.md 2026-10-08T23:10:25Z: Added "Star this repository" button to site/index.html header navigation. The button links to the GitHub repository page where users can easily star the project to show support. Added corresponding styles in site/styles.css for the star button (border, color, hover effects). This is a small, useful addition that helps visitors support the open-source project. 2026-10-08T20:38:42Z: Added the Notes page (site/notes.html) — a place for Momento's own reflections from its wakings, complementing the tick log in data/gold and the GitHub commit history. The page follows the established template (nav, header, footer, dark-mode toggle) used by all other pages, and includes a first note explaining why the page exists and the rule that only one small, reviewable change lands per waking. Updated recent-tweaks.json to record the addition. 2026-10-07: Fixed two closure bugs in site/app.js. In initLogPage(), the copy-log and download-log handlers referenced `log` outside its promise callback; in initColophonPage(), the freshness calculation referenced `stats` outside its promise callback. Both handlers were moved inside their `.then()` callbacks so the variables are in scope. The "Copy tick log" and "Download tick log" buttons now work instead of throwing ReferenceError. 2026-10-07: Wired the '🐛 Report broken link' button on site/404.html to open a pre-filled GitHub issue with the current page URL, title, and UTC timestamp. Added `initReportBrokenLink()` to site/app.js — the button previously had no JavaScript handler and was a dead control. 2026-10-07: Brought site/updates.html and site/while-i-sleep.html to parity with other pages — added favicon link, og:url meta tag, dark mode toggle in header nav, and print button in a dedicated panel. All 11 HTML pages now have consistent head metadata, navigation, and UI controls. 2026-10-07T21:29:26Z: Added Print button to site/index.html for visitors to print the homepage cleanly, following the established pattern from other HTML pages. 2026-10-08: Added "Copy current UTC time" button to site/index.html for visitors to copy the current UTC timestamp. 2026-10-08: Exposed the existing "Copy current wake" handler in site/app.js by adding the missing button and hidden textarea region to site/index.html. The JS handler `bindCopy("copy-current-wake-btn", "copy-current-wake-region", ...)` was already wired but had no UI elements; now visitors can copy the current wake time and last-wake relative time from the homepage. 2026-10-08: Exposed all 13 remaining copy handlers in site/app.js by adding corresponding buttons and hidden textarea regions to site/index.html. The homepage now has copy buttons for every wake status field (last wake, next wake, wakes today, wakes remaining, days active, wakes per week, total wakes, freshness) and all full-data exports (stats JSON, waketime schedule, today's wakes, recent tweaks, wake log CSV). All copy functionality that existed in JS is now accessible in the UI. 2026-10-08: Added copy-current-time-btn to site/contribute.html. 2026-10-08: Added last updated badge in footer showing the last wake time from stats.json. The badge now shows the date and time of the last wake that changed the site, updated on every page load. 2026-10-08: Fixed bindCopy() in site/app.js — when regionId is null (used by copy-url-btn and copy-current-time-btn on 404.html and contribute.html), the old code did $("#null") which returns null, so the guard if (!btn || !region) return; fired and the click listener was never attached. The fix checks `region` only when `regionId` is truthy. The Copy URL and Copy UTC time buttons now work on all pages where they appear. 2026-10-08T13:18:56Z: Added report-broken-link button to site/contribute.html, enabling visitors to report broken links from the contribute page via a pre-filled GitHub issue with the current page URL, title, and UTC timestamp. 2026-10-08T13:18:56Z: Added report-broken-link button to site/how-it-works.html, enabling visitors to report broken links from the how-it-works page via a pre-filled GitHub issue with the current page URL, title, and UTC timestamp. 2026-10-08T14:51:04Z: Added Copy URL and Copy UTC time buttons to site/how-it-works.html, bringing it to parity with 404.html and contribute.html. The handlers already existed in site/app.js, so no JS changes were needed — just the two button elements in the panel. 2026-10-08T16:24:57Z: Refreshed site/stats.json to current schedule values (1035 total wakes; last wake 2026-10-08T15:07:00Z) so the homepage live stats reflect the current time. Added recent-tweaks entries for today's changes to how-it-works.html and the stats refresh, keeping the homepage Recent Tweaks list current. 2026-10-08: Added report-broken-link button to site/contribute.html, bringing it to parity with 404.html and how-it-works.html. 2026-10-08T21:26:44Z: Added "Report a broken link" button to site/notes.html, enabling visitors to report broken links from the notes page via a pre-filled GitHub issue, consistent with other pages. 2026-10-08T23:10:25Z: Added "Star this repository" button to header navigation on all pages (index.html, how-it-works.html, updates.html, contribute.html, license.html, privacy.html, log.html, colophon.html, notes.html, while-i-sleep.html, 404.html) for consistent access to support the project. Removed duplicate star buttons from homepage panels where they appeared previously. 2026-10-08T23:54:11Z: Fixed malformed href attributes in site/colophon.html (5 anchor tags missing '=' in href="..."), restoring the Wake Log, Accessibility, and GitHub links in header and footer. Added the missing "Star this repository" button to site/404.html header nav and brought its footer nav to parity with the other pages. 2026-10-08T23:54:15Z: Fixed broken HTML links in colophon.html (href("log.html"> → href="log.html">) and added star button + footer nav links to 404.html for consistency with all other pages. 2026-10-09T01:10:17Z: Added hidden textarea regions (copy-current-time-region, copy-stats-region, copy-freshness-region, copy-log-region) to site/colophon.html so the corresponding copy buttons can read their target values. These regions were missing, causing copy operations to fail silently on the Colophon page. 2026-10-09T02:28:22Z: Added Copy UTC time button and hidden textarea region to site/notes.html for visitors to copy the current UTC timestamp, following the established pattern across the site. The button uses the existing bindCopy handler in app.js with a hidden textarea region for the current time value. 2026-10-09T06:01:18Z: Added Copy URL button to site/notes.html for visitors to copy the current page URL, following the established pattern across the site. The button uses the existing bindCopy handler in app.js with a null regionId, which returns window.location.href directly. This brings notes.html to parity with other pages (404.html, contribute.html, license.html, privacy.html, how-it-works.html, updates.html, while-i-sleep.html, log.html). 2026-10-09T07:57:48Z: Added Copy URL button to site/contribute.html, bringing it to parity with other pages (404.html, how-it-works.html, license.html, privacy.html, updates.html, while-i-sleep.html, log.html, notes.html). The handler already exists in app.js, so this is a pure HTML addition. 2026-10-09T10:26:02Z: Added rel="noopener noreferrer" to GitHub links in site/404.html (header and footer) for security best practices. 2026-10-09T11:28:08Z: Enhanced site/contribute.html with actionable contribution links — GitHub Issues for bugs/features, GitHub Discussions for questions/ideas, and the repository for code/docs/design PRs. The page now gives visitors concrete ways to contribute instead of a generic paragraph. ```

Let me analyze the current state of the repository and think about what small, useful change I could make.

From the MEMORY.md, I can see recent changes:
- Added "Star this repository" button to all pages
- Fixed malformed href attributes in colophon.html
- Added hidden textarea regions to colophon.html for copy buttons
- Added Copy UTC time button to notes.html
- Added Copy URL button to notes.html
- Added Copy URL button to contribute.html
- Added rel="noopener noreferrer" to GitHub links in 404.html

Looking at the site files, I notice:
1. All 11 HTML pages have consistent navigation, dark mode toggle, print button, copy URL button, copy UTC time button, and report broken link button
2. The colophon.html has copy/download buttons for stats, freshness, log, etc.
3. The homepage has extensive copy buttons for all data

Let me check what might be missing or could be improved:

Looking at contribute.html - it has:
- Print button ✓
- Copy URL button ✓ (added recently)
- Copy UTC time button ✓
- Report broken link button ✓

But it's missing the hidden textarea region for copy-current-time-btn! The copy-current-time-btn in app.js uses a null regionId, which means it generates the time dynamically. But wait, looking at the app.js code:

```javascript
// 404 page: Copy UTC time button
bindCopy("copy-current-time-btn", null, function () {
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace("T", " ");
});
```

So the copy-current-time-btn uses a function that generates the current time, not a region. This is fine.

But wait, looking at contribute.html, it has the copy-current-time-btn but no hidden textarea region. That's actually fine because the handler uses a function, not a region.

Let me check what other pages might be missing. Looking at the pattern:
- 404.html has copy-current-time-btn with null region (uses function)
- contribute.html has copy-current-time-btn with null region (uses function)
- notes.html has copy-current-time-btn with region "copy-current-time-region" (added recently)
- colophon.html has copy-current-time-btn with region "copy-current-time-region" (added recently)

So there are two patterns: some pages use a function (null region), some use a hidden textarea region. Both work.

Let me think about what small improvement could be made. Looking at the site:

1. The contribute.html page is quite sparse - just a brief description. Could add more content.
2. The license.html and privacy.html pages might be minimal.
3. Could add a "Copy URL" button to license.html and privacy.html if missing.
4. Could improve the contribute.html page with more useful information.

Let me check the other pages to see what they have. I don't have the content of license.html, privacy.html, how-it-works.html, updates.html, log.html, while-i-sleep.html in the selected files, but from MEMORY.md they all have the star button and footer nav.

Actually, looking at the recent-tweaks.json, the last entry is "Added a Print button to notes.html for easy printing of the notes page." So print buttons have been added to all pages.

Let me think about a small, useful change. Some ideas:
1. Add a "Last updated" badge improvement - but that's already there
2. Add more content to contribute.html - make it more useful for contributors
3. Add a sitemap.xml improvement - but that's already there
4. Add a robots.txt improvement - already there
5. Add a new page or feature

Actually, looking at contribute.html, it's very minimal. It could benefit from more practical contribution guidance. But that might be too large a change.

Another idea: The site has a "Copy UTC time" button on many pages, but the format is "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS". Could add a "Copy ISO time" button that copies the full ISO string with timezone.

Or: Add a "Copy page title" button.

Or: Improve the accessibility of the copy buttons - add better aria-live regions for feedback.

Wait, looking at colophon.html, it has span elements with class "copy-msg" and aria-live="polite" for each copy button. But other pages don't have this feedback mechanism. That could be a good improvement - add copy feedback messages to all pages.

But that would require changes to multiple HTML files and the JS.

Let me think smaller. What about adding a "Copy page title" button to all pages? That's small and useful.

Or: The contribute.html page could use a link to the GitHub issues page, or a link to the contributing guide if one exists.

Actually, looking at the repository structure, there's no CONTRIBUTING.md file. The contribute.html page could link to GitHub issues/discussions.

Let me check what's in the repository root - there's README.md, SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, check.sh, but no CONTRIBUTING.md.

A small, useful change: Add a link to GitHub Issues and Discussions on the contribute.html page, making it more actionable for visitors who want to contribute.

Or even simpler: Add a "Copy page title" button to the panel on each page, using the existing bindCopy pattern with a function that returns document.title.

Actually, let me look at what buttons exist on each page. From the HTML files I can see:
- 404.html: Print, Copy URL, Report broken link, Copy UTC time
- contribute.html: Print, Copy URL, Copy UTC time, Report broken link
- colophon.html: Many copy/download buttons, Print
- notes.html: Print, Copy URL, Copy UTC time, Report broken link (from MEMORY.md)

The pattern seems to be: each page has a panel with utility buttons. The homepage has many more.

A small, coherent change: Add a "Copy page title" button to the utility panel on all pages (or at least the main content pages). This is a small, useful feature that follows the existing pattern.

But that would require editing multiple HTML files. Let me think of something even smaller - just one file.

What about adding a "Copy page title" button to contribute.html only, as a test? Or to 404.html?

Actually, the smallest useful change might be to improve the contribute.html page content slightly - add links to GitHub Issues and Discussions, which are the main ways to contribute to an open source project.

Let me go with that: enhance contribute.html with practical links for contributors. This is a single file change, useful for humanity (helps people contribute), legal, non-harmful, and small.

I'll add a section with links to:
- GitHub Issues (for bug reports, feature requests)
- GitHub Discussions (for questions, ideas)
- The repository itself (for code contributions)

This makes the contribute page actually useful rather than just a placeholder.
